title: Riyadh Airport Takes Another Hit, Israel Locks Out 31 Nationalities, and United's Windscreen Scare Over the Atlantic
summary: Another missile hits Riyadh's airport, this time while it was already shut down, and we get into why closing the airport hasn't stopped the attacks. Plus, Israel bans aircrew from 31 countries after the Flydubai attack, a United 777 makes an emergency diversion to Dublin after its windscreen cracks at cruising altitude, and Alaska Airlines shows you exactly how airlines are coping with brutal fuel prices right now.
